entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, GRANTS AND DISBURSEMENTS FOR BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND TECHNOLOGY, KAHULUI, MAKAWAO-PĀʻIA-HAʻIKŪ, PUKALANI-KULA-ʻULUPALAKUA, MOLOKAI, SOUTH MAUI, AND WEST MAUI ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, ENVIRONMENTAL, AND CULTURAL PROGRAMS" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, Office of the Mayor, Economic Development Program, Grants and disbursements for business and technology to 1) condition Kahului Economic Development, Environmental, and Cultural Programs by adding line items for Hale Mahaolu, Meals on Wheels Program, in the amount of $30,000 and Maui Economic Opportunity, Inc.
